props.subTitle: More Than a Hairstyle
props.title: Hair Braiding for Style, Comfort, and Everyday Wear
props.text: Hair braiding is more than a fashion trend. It is a practical hairstyle that helps keep hair neat, manageable, and protected throughout busy days in Bali. From beach clubs and sightseeing to special events and everyday activities, braided hairstyles reduce tangling in humid weather while offering a personalised look that suits different hair lengths, and occasions.
props.feature1Text: Helps reduce tangles and keeps hair organised throughout the day.
props.feature2Text: Choose from classic, modern, or customised braid styles to match your look.

props.subTitle: Hair Length Options
props.title: Choose the Style That Fits Your Hair
props.text: Pricing is based on hair length, allowing enough time to create neat, balanced braids while adapting the technique to your preferred style and overall hair volume.

props.subTitle: Very Popular
props.title: Why Many Visitors Choose Hair Braiding in Bali
props.text: Hair braiding is a practical and stylish choice for many tourists in Bali. Braids can help keep hair manageable in the island's warm, humid climate while making everyday styling easier during a holiday. They often choose braiding for benefits such as:
featuresLeft: Keeping hair neat in Bali's tropical climate
Reducing tangling caused by wind and humidity
Making hair easier to manage during swimming and beach activities
featuresRight: Creating a convenient style for holidays, events, and festivals
Maintaining a low-maintenance hairstyle for several days

props.subTitle: Your Custom Style
props.title: Every Braid Starts with the Right Plan
props.text: Before braiding begins, we discuss your preferred hairstyle, braid size, hair length, and whether you'd like to include extensions. Each section of hair is carefully prepared before braiding to create an even, comfortable finish. Once complete, we'll also share simple aftercare tips to help your hairstyle stay neat for longer. The process covers:

items.question: Is Hair Braiding suitable for all hair types?
items.answer: Yes. Most hair types can be braided, and the technique is adjusted according to your hair's length, texture, and condition.

items.question: How long does Hair Braiding usually take?
items.answer: Depending on the chosen style, appointments generally take between 30 minutes and 2 hours.

items.question: Will braiding damage my hair?
items.answer: When done correctly, braiding is considered a protective hairstyle. We avoid excessive tension to keep your scalp comfortable.

items.question: How long do braids usually last?
items.answer: The lifespan depends on the braid style, daily activities, and aftercare. Many styles remain neat for several days or even longer.

items.question: Can I bring a reference photo?
items.answer: Absolutely. Reference photos help us better understand the style, braid pattern, and overall look you'd like to achieve.

items.question: Are hair extensions available?
items.answer: Yes. Selected braid styles can be created with extensions for additional length or volume.

props.title: A Hairstyle That Keeps Up with Your Bali Plans
props.text: Beach mornings, sunset dinners, island tours: the right braids let you enjoy them without fixing your hair. Personalised styling, comfortable to wear and easy to keep.
props.closingText: Reserve your Hair Braiding appointment and create a style made for your Bali plans.
